desc:
Ranch Tycoon! 🦆

Step into the world of building, maintaining and protecting your very own Ranch!

-------------------------------------------------

- Build up your own Ranch piece by piece! 🏗️

- Purchase a variety of different animals! 🐐

- Protect your animals from vicious predator attacks! 🐺

- Feed and take care of your animals! 🥕

- Build your ranch to impress the visitors! 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦

Your Ranch adventure begins today!

--------------------------------------------------

🔔Unlock Auto-Feed at first rebirth and Auto-clean at second rebirth! 🔔

🐞Report bugs on the group wall! 🐞
